'''Seirin''' is an [[Aiel]] from the [[Shorara]] sept and the [[Tomanelle]] clan. 

== Activities ==
He is the young Aiel who gives the message to [[Rand al'Thor]] that the four unaffiliated Aiel clans are starting to move, during the battle outside [[Cairhien]].
